title: keeper-log-compliance-day-brief-harper-2026-06-25
body:
Harper's SOC2 keeper log — quick personal notes and action list

Date: 2026-06-25 (working copy)
Context: Morning pass on evidence backlog, vendor mini-reviews, and a short doc draft for quarterly access-review cadence. Keeping this intentionally terse.

-- Morning timeline (rough) --
08:30 — triage evidence queue (see SEC-3472) — found 3 missing attestations for third-party ingestion paths
09:15 — sync with Maya (15m) — she owns LogStream evidence uploads; flagged offsets in S3 path layout
10:00 — quick vendor checks (KeyVaultCo, LogStream, Vaultless) — notes below
11:00 — start draft: quarterly access review cadence (skeleton) — rough headings in policy TODO section
11:30 — ping infra for archive retention proof (PR linked)

-- Action checklist (prioritized) --
[ ] Attach auth flow diagrams for ingestion pipeline (needed for SEC-3523) — where to get: infra/diagrams/ingest-auth.drawio (ask Tomas if missing)
[ ] Confirm KeyVaultCo SOC2 cert and subprocessor list — deadline EOD 2026-06-28
[ ] Get signed DPA for Vaultless (legal chase) — open: LEGAL-528
[ ] Upload LogStream access logs to evidence bucket and tag with jira key — assigned to Maya
[ ] Finish policy draft: Access Review cadence + sample attendee list — 1st pass today, review with Ethan tomorrow
[ ] Re-run evidence checklist script (local) and capture output as artifact (capture name: evidence-scan-harper-2026-06-25.txt)

Notes to self: use consistent artifact naming (team-evidence-<area>-YYYYMMDD). Stop creating ad-hoc filenames.

-- Vendor mini-reviews (quick sniff tests) --
KeyVaultCo:
- Quick take: holds KMS for dedup keys; public cert on portal shows last audit 2025 (need SOC2 report).
- Missing: subprocessor disclosure + key rotation policy excerpt. Email vendor contact: sara@keyvaultco.com.
- Quick risk flag: they permit multi-tenant backups stored unencrypted at rest (ask for clarification).

LogStream:
- They provide logging aggregator (we ingest for telemetry). Maya says logs land in aws-account-logs/rlw/2026/ — check retention tags.
- Evidence: screenshot of console retention + export job logs should be enough. Confirm retention >= 90 days per our policy.

Vaultless (new small vendor):
- No formal SOC2 on site. They provided ISO-ish whitepaper. Legal wants DPA + security questionnaire filled.
- Quick decision: treat as moderate risk until DPA signed; limit scope of PII flows.

-- Policy TODO (skeleton to expand) --
Title: Quarterly Access Review — Owner: SecOps (rotating)
- Purpose: ensure least privilege across prod, logs, and infra
- Scope: Redwood Inference accounts, service principals, third-party vendor access (read/write scopes)
- Frequency: quarterly (default) + targeted after major infra changes
- Attendees: SecOps lead, Infra oncall, Product security rep, Owner of affected service
- Evidence: minutes doc + attestation checklist (signed by attendees)
- Next steps: draft template + example for RBAC groups — due 2026-07-02

-- Evidence mapping (where to put files) --
- Ingest auth diagrams -> evidence/prod/ingest-auth/ingest-auth-harper-20260625.drawio
- KeyVaultCo SOC2 -> evidence/vendor/keyvaultco/keyvaultco-SOC2-2025.pdf (if vendor provides)
- LogStream retention proof -> evidence/vendor/logstream/retention-2026-06-25.png
- Vaultless DPA draft -> evidence/vendor/vaultless/dpa-draft-v1.docx
- Scan output -> evidence/scans/evidence-scan-harper-2026-06-25.txt

-- Quick scripts & commands I ran (for personal reproducibility) --
# local: run evidence scan (w/ env stub)
$ ./scripts/evidence-scan --area=ingest --out=./evidence/scans/evidence-scan-harper-2026-06-25.txt
# aws: list retention tags (quick)
$ aws s3api get-bucket-tagging --bucket redwood-logs-rlw | jq .TagSet

-- Open questions / followups --
- Does KeyVaultCo encrypt backups at rest? (asked vendor — waiting)
- Can LogStream provide a signed CSV export of retention config? (ask Maya to request)
- Legal: any templated DPA for small vendors? (ping legal@redwood.ai)

-- Slack references / threads --
- pki-rotation-2026-06-23 (notes I posted)
- #sec-compliance pinned: evidence-upload-template.docx

-- End quick log --
Small, messy, meant for daily grooming. Will spin a cleaner handoff note when wrapping this queue.
